token は Langfuse の実測（GENERATION 単位、保持 14 日、Task Board は run 終了後に export）。枠 used% と実増分は Prometheus の実測（アカウント全体、1%刻み、reset 区間は除外）。票別の pt は token × 係数の**推定**で quota 実測ではありません。

| 窓 | モデル | 下限〜上限 | R² |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claude shared_7d | claude-fable-5-1 | 0.072〜0.101 | 0.85〜0.92 |
| Claude shared_7d | claude-fable-5-2 | 0.072〜0.101 | 0.85〜0.92 |
| Claude shared_7d | claude-opus-5-5 | 0.02〜0.023 | 0.85〜0.92 |
| Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) | claude-fable-5-1 | 0.16〜0.21 | 0.87〜0.93 |
| Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) | claude-fable-5-2 | 0.16〜0.21 | 0.87〜0.93 |
| Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) | claude-opus-5-5 | 0.0〜0.003 | 0.87〜0.93 |
| Codex primary | gpt-6.1-sol | 0.069〜0.083 | 0.73〜0.78 |
| Codex primary | gpt-6.1-terra | 0.074〜0.081 | 0.73〜0.78 |

対象期間: 2026-11-09T07:00:00Z〜2026-11-16T07:00:00Z、推定日: 2026-11-16。出典: BOXP-567 6h/12h 回帰 (Projects/model-usage-attribution/evidence/ols-6h.txt, ols-12h.txt)。基準: total_tokens (cache read を含む全 token)、単位: pt / 100万 token。期間外は外挿で、モデル更新や構成変化で変わるため毎週見直します。

窓の種類: Claude shared_7d は全 Claude モデル共有、fable_7d は Fable 専用（Fable は両方を同時に減らします）、Codex primary は Hermes を含む Codex 共有です。推定 pt は token から計算するので reset の影響を受けません。実測の増加 pt は reset を含む区間を除外するため、reset をまたぐ期間では実測が推定より小さく見えます。

同時実行の run は token が加算されるだけなので重複しません（run ごとの used% 差分は重なるため使いません）。Hermes（Telegram/家の Web/Webhook/cron）は票番号がないので「(票なし)」1 区分で、票へ配りません。5 時間窓と同時実行制限は未観測です。Langfuse の Claude 親は local 記録より約 26% 少ない既知の欠落があり（BOXP-567、例 BOXP-428 が丸ごと欠落）、票別値は過小になりえます。cache read を含む total を基準にしています。会話本文は表示しません。

panels.title: 見方・実測と推定の区別

targets.expr: sum_over_time(((max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_used_percent{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"}) - max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_used_percent{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"} offset 1m)) unless on(provider,name,limit,window) (abs(max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_resets_at_seconds{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"}) - max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_resets_at_seconds{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"} offset 1m)) > 3600))[$__interval:1m])

panels.title: 実測：bin ごとの増加 pt（reset 区間除外）

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(start_time, toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)) AS time, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude shared_7d`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用)`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary` FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 推定：bin ごとの pt（中央値・窓別）

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Claude shared_7d' AS `窓`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.072, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.072, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.02, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.101, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.101, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.023, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 上限`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') AS `票あり 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') AS `票なし 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') + sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') - sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `票あり+票なし-中央 差分`, (SELECT sum(n) FROM (SELECT sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS n FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY toStartOfInterval(start_time, toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)))) - sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `bin 合計-中央 差分`, sumIf(total_tokens, model NOT IN ('claude-fable-5-1', 'claude-fable-5-2', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'gpt-6.1-terra')) AS `係数なし token` FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 'Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用)' AS `窓`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.16, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.16, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.21, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.21, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.003, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 上限`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') AS `票あり 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') AS `票なし 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') + sumIf(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') - sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `票あり+票なし-中央 差分`, (SELECT sum(n) FROM (SELECT sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS n FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY toStartOfInterval(start_time, toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)))) - sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `bin 合計-中央 差分`, sumIf(total_tokens, model NOT IN ('claude-fable-5-1', 'claude-fable-5-2', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'gpt-6.1-terra')) AS `係数なし token` FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) UNION ALL SELECT 'Codex primary' AS `窓`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.069, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.074, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.083, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.081, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `推定 上限`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') AS `票あり 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') AS `票なし 中央`, sumIf(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket != '') + sumIf(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6, ticket = '') - sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `票あり+票なし-中央 差分`, (SELECT sum(n) FROM (SELECT sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS n FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY toStartOfInterval(start_time, toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)))) - sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `bin 合計-中央 差分`, sumIf(total_tokens, model NOT IN ('claude-fable-5-1', 'claude-fable-5-2', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'gpt-6.1-terra')) AS `係数なし token` FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote})

panels.description: 推定 中央との比較は ticket/model/route/provider がすべて All の場合のみ。実測が推定より大きい分は、Langfuse に届かなかった run（Claude 親の欠落など）、Pod 外の利用、係数の誤差のどれかで、票へは配れません。

targets.expr: sum_over_time(((max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_used_percent{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"}) - max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_used_percent{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"} offset 1m)) unless on(provider,name,limit,window) (abs(max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_resets_at_seconds{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"}) - max by (provider,name,limit,window) (ai_subscription_window_resets_at_seconds{job="codex-workspace-ai-ops-metrics"} offset 1m)) > 3600))[$__range:1m])

panels.title: 実測：選択期間の増加 pt（reset 区間除外）

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) AS ticket_label, groupUniqArray(model) AS models, groupUniqArray(route) AS routes, uniqExact(trace_id) AS runs, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens_sum, sum(cache_read_tokens) AS cache_read_tokens_sum, sum(cache_write_tokens) AS cache_write_tokens_sum, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens_sum, sum(total_tokens) AS total_tokens_sum, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.072, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.072, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.02, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude shared_7d 推定 pt 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.0865, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.0865, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0215, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude shared_7d 推定 pt 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.101, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.101, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.023, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude shared_7d 推定 pt 上限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.16, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.16, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) 推定 pt 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.185, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.185, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.0015, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) 推定 pt 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'claude-fable-5-1', 0.21, model = 'claude-fable-5-2', 0.21, model = 'claude-opus-5-5', 0.003, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Claude fable_7d (Fable 専用) 推定 pt 上限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.069, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.074, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.083, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.081, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 上限`, sumIf(total_tokens, model NOT IN ('claude-fable-5-1', 'claude-fable-5-2', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'gpt-6.1-terra')) AS `係数なし token`, 100.0 * sumIf(total_tokens, start_time < toDateTime64('2026-11-09 07:00:00',3,'UTC') OR start_time >= toDateTime64('2026-11-16 07:00:00',3,'UTC')) / nullIf(sum(total_tokens), 0) AS `係数期間外 %`, min(start_time) AS first_JST, max(start_time) AS last_JST FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY ticket_label ORDER BY total_tokens_sum DESC LIMIT 200

推定 pt 上限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.069, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.074, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 下限`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.076, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.0775, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 中央`, sum(multiIf(model = 'gpt-6.1-sol', 0.083, model = 'gpt-6.1-terra', 0.081, 0) * total_tokens / 1e6) AS `Codex primary 推定 pt 上限`, sumIf(total_tokens, model NOT IN ('claude-fable-5-1', 'claude-fable-5-2', 'claude-opus-5-5', 'gpt-6.1-sol', 'gpt-6.1-terra')) AS `係数なし token`, 100.0 * sumIf(total_tokens, start_time < targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(start_time, toIntervalSecond($__interval_s)) AS time, model, sum(input_tokens+cache_write_tokens+output_tokens+reasoning_tokens) AS value FROM ai_ops_usage_v1 WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND model IN (${model:singlequote}) AND route IN (${route:singlequote}) AND provider IN (${provider:singlequote}) AND if(ticket = '', '(票なし)', ticket) IN (${ticket:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

title: AI Ops 票別・実モデル別 使用量と推定枠消費
